s4-binary-search-to-find-x-in-sorted-arr.trick: Repeatedly discard the half that cannot contain the target.

s4-implement-lower-bound.trick: Find the first position whose value is at least x; the answer may be n.

s4-implement-upper-bound.trick: Find the first position whose value is strictly greater than x.

s4-search-insert-position.trick: The insertion point is exactly the lower-bound position.

s4-floor-ceil-in-sorted-array.trick: The first value at least x is the ceil; its predecessor is the floor unless x itself is present.

s4-find-the-first-or-last-occurrence-of-.trick: Lower bound finds the first x; upper bound minus one finds the last x.

s4-count-occurrences-of-a-number-in-a-so.trick: Count elements equal to x as upper_bound(x) minus lower_bound(x).

s4-search-in-rotated-sorted-array-i.trick: One half is always sorted; decide whether the target lies in that half.

s4-search-in-rotated-sorted-array-ii.trick: Use the sorted-half test; when both ends equal mid, discard duplicate ends safely.

s4-find-minimum-in-rotated-sorted-array.trick: Compare mid with the right end: if mid is larger, the minimum is to its right; otherwise keep mid.

s4-find-out-how-many-times-has-an-array-.trick: The index of the minimum element is the rotation count for distinct sorted values.

s4-single-element-in-a-sorted-array.trick: Before the singleton, pairs start at even indices; after it, that parity flips.

s4-find-peak-element.trick: Follow the rising slope: if mid < mid+1, a peak exists to the right; otherwise it exists at or left of mid.

s4-find-square-root-of-a-number-in-log-n.trick: Binary-search the largest integer whose square does not exceed n, using mid <= n/mid to avoid overflow.

s4-find-the-nth-root-of-a-number-using-b.trick: Binary-search an integer root; compare powers by division so multiplication cannot overflow.

s4-koko-eating-bananas.trick: Eating at speed k needs sum(ceil(pile/k)) hours; binary-search the smallest feasible speed.

s4-minimum-days-to-make-m-bouquets.trick: On a chosen day, scan for runs of k bloomed flowers; binary-search the earliest day that makes m bouquets.

s4-find-the-smallest-divisor.trick: The rounded-up quotient sum falls as the divisor grows; binary-search the first divisor meeting the threshold.

s4-capacity-to-ship-packages-within-d-da.trick: For each capacity, greedily load packages in order into days; binary-search the smallest feasible capacity.

s4-kth-missing-positive-number.trick: At index i, arr[i]-(i+1) positive integers are missing; binary-search the first index with at least k missing.

s4-aggressive-cows.trick: Sort stalls, greedily place each cow as early as possible, and binary-search the greatest feasible minimum gap.
s4-aggressive-cows.time: O(n log n + n log range)

s4-book-allocation-problem.trick: Greedily form the fewest contiguous student groups under a page limit; binary-search the smallest valid limit.

s4-split-array-largest-sum.trick: Under a candidate maximum sum, greedily make the fewest contiguous parts; binary-search the first limit needing at most k parts.

s4-painter-s-partition.trick: Each painter gets a contiguous block. Greedily count painters needed under a time limit, then binary-search the minimum limit.

s4-minimize-max-distance-to-gas-station.trick: For a proposed maximum gap d, each original gap needs ceil(gap/d)-1 extra stations; binary-search d.

s4-median-of-2-sorted-arrays.trick: Partition the smaller array so the left halves contain half the elements; adjust until both left maxima are no greater than opposite right minima.

s4-kth-element-of-2-sorted-arrays.trick: Choose how many of the first k elements come from the smaller array; binary-search a valid partition.

s4-find-the-row-with-maximum-number-of-1.trick: Binary-search the first 1 in each sorted row, then keep the row with the largest suffix of ones.

s4-search-in-a-2-d-matrix.trick: When rows are globally ordered, treat the matrix as one sorted array and map index to row and column.

s4-search-in-a-row-and-column-wise-sorte.trick: Start at the top right: move left if too large, down if too small.

s4-find-peak-element-2d-matrix.trick: Binary-search columns; choose that column's maximum and move toward a larger horizontal neighbor.

s4-matrix-median.trick: For row-sorted data, binary-search the value whose count of elements at most it first exceeds half the total.
